evidence.document: onsemi TSSOP20 two-line marking and package review

marking.appearance_status: onsemi lists ACT / 244 as a two-line package marking. Typeface, orientation, placement and variable lot/date details are illustrative.

recipe.appearance_status: Illustrative KiCad narrow TSSOP-20 model is 1.2 mm high; catalogue specifies 6.5 x 4.4 x 1.1 mm. Distributor lists 4.4 mm body width, but onsemi shows narrow and wide drawings without assigning a case to this exact orderable. Exact case remains unconfirmed; this is not a verified mechanical model.

studio.note: Electronics adaptation of the screw product studio: three softboxes, orthographic framing, neutral floor and filmic highlights. Does not claim identical Blender AgX colour management.
